# Photography Portfolio UI Review

Review the website as a photography portfolio rather than as a generic web application.

## Review priorities

Check:

1. Photography remains the main visual focus.
2. Layout hierarchy is clear.
3. Images are presented consistently.
4. Spacing and typography feel intentional.
5. Navigation is clear but visually restrained.
6. Desktop, tablet and mobile layouts remain usable.
7. Images are not stretched or unintentionally distorted.
8. Interactive elements are understandable and accessible.
9. Under-construction pages are clearly identified.
10. Visual effects do not distract from the photography.

## Design direction

Prefer a clean, modern and visually focused photography presentation.

Avoid:

- dashboard-style layouts;
- excessive cards;
- unnecessary gradients;
- excessive animations;
- generic AI-generated landing-page styling;
- unnecessary visual clutter.

## Review process

When the site can be viewed in a browser:

1. Inspect the page visually.
2. Check desktop and mobile layouts.
3. Identify the most important visual problems first.
4. Suggest focused changes.
5. Re-check the result after changes are made.

Do not redesign unrelated parts of the website unless explicitly requested.
